entry_age.span: Patients who were 18 years of age or older (with no upper age limit) and who were hospitalized with Covid-19 pneumonia that had been confirmed by a positive polymerase-chain-reaction test and radiographic imaging were eligible for enrollment.

notes: The served serious-adverse-event counts are from the safety population grouped by actual treatment received, through day 60; the served modified intention-to-treat label is incorrect.
